name: Panhalgad (Panhala Town)
description: Panhala is a historic hill town built around the massive Panhala Fort. It was a key Maratha stronghold and the site of Shivaji Maharaj's famous escape from Siddi Johar. The town is dotted with ancient temples, gateways, and granaries.
historicalSignificance: Capital of the Maratha kingdom for a period, site of the siege and escape of Shivaji Maharaj (1660).
reviews: A living fort town with vibrant history.
Great for a weekend getaway with family.
The fort and town are both worth exploring.
